questions.questionTextHi: [60th to 62nd B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2016] What is the name of mid-latitude grassland in South America?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Pampas. Mid-latitudes or temperate belt grasslands of South America is known as Pampas. It is spread over Argentina, Uruguay and southern parts of Brazil. questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following natural regions is known as 'Land of Big Games'?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2019] Which one of the following natural regions is known as 'Land of Big Games'?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Tropical Savanna Region. Land of Big Games is known as the Tropical Savanna region, as thousands of animals are trapped or killed each year by people from all over the world. There are two main groups of animals in the savanna, the grass-eating herbivorous animals and the flesh-eating carnivorous animals. The herbivorous include the zebra, antelope, Giraf, deer, gazelle, elephant etc. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2019]

questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2021] The vegetation of savannah consists of grassland with scattered small trees, but extensive areas have no trees. Fire 3. Grazing herbivores 4. Seasonal rainfall 5. Soil properties Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) 2, 3 and 4. The main obstacle in the development of forest in the savanna grassland is the abundance of grass-grazing animals, fi re in this area and seasonal rainfall.
